text: The Ultra Diamond Slair is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Longsword.

Upa Embers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Itmos Upas in Makna Forest or traded for with two Nopon in Frontier Village. According to their description, their ethereal flames accompany departed souls to the afterlife. Three are needed for Material Quest 4 (Frontier Village).

Vangarre (Japanese: , Vandamu, Vandamme; English dub: ) is a Homs in . He is the Colonel of Colony 9's Defence Force, and is known for his angry, impatient, and bossy attitude. Many residents believe he trains the Defence Force poorly, frequently assigning nearly impossible tasks to his inexperienced subordinates, as well as administering harsh punishments (including physical abuse) when they fail. Reyn nicknames him "Square-Tache".

, a Unique Monster]] Unique Monsters (Japanese: , yunīku monsutā) are enemies in and that have higher stats and potentially unique skills — similar to minibosses or superbosses in other games. Unique Monsters have unique names and there is only one of each of these monsters in the world. There are 157 Unique Monsters, the only ones giving Affinity Coins when defeated. Five of them are Superbosses, and eight of them are quest-exclusive. When a Unique Monster is slain for the first time in a given playthrough, each character of the entire party will earn an Affinity Coin. Slaying the same monster again will not give additional Affinity Coins. However, in New Game +, the Affinity Coin is

Ultramarine Ants (Japanese: , Gunjouari) are collectables in . They can be found in Galahad Fortress and Colony 6 or traded for with Prox on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they are azure ants with giant jaws that toils stoically for their queen.

Utopia Crocuses (Japanese: , Narukoyurirarudo) are collectables in . They can be found in Mechonis Field and Colony 6. According to their description, they look just like pieces of beryl that have come into bloom and their glow enthralls others.

Vang Milk Teeth are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Vangs in Satorl Marsh, and cannot be traded for. According to their description, they are fleshy teeth that are soft so as not to damage the inside of the mouth. Four of them are needed for Let's Make Fillings!.

Upas (Japanese: , Ūpā) are a species of enemy in the . They have an appearance somewhat similar to Lizards, but with a large lure on their heads which lights up at night. Upas undergo no appearance change between games.
Vang (Japanese: , Vanpu, Vamp) are bat-like enemies found in the . They are generally found at night or in caves. There is no appearance change between games.
Uranus Drones are Mechonis Drones in Xenoblade Chronicles. They provide the Sword Drones II talent art. They can be dropped by the Magnificent Digalus.

Vang Hair Clips are rare materials in . They can be obtained from Shadow Vangs and the Shadeless Matrix in Colony 9. They can also be traded for with Rosemary before she moves to Colony 6. According to their description, they are hair accessories made from part of a Vang and little girls love them. Two are needed for Betty's Gift.
Vangarre Drivers (Japanese: , Vandamubankā) are weapons in . They are Gunlances wielded by Reyn and are most likely named after Vangarre, the Colonel of the Colony 9 Defence Force.

Unique is a title used to refer to Weapons or Armour in and that come with unremovable Gems equipped. Unique armour may only have one such gem, while unique weapons may have up to three. All unique items feature a "U" on the icon in game. Unique equipment can only be dropped by enemies in gold chests.
Utopia (Japanese: , Yūtopia) were weapons designed for Xenoblade Chronicles. They were twin blades to be wielded by Fiora, however for unknown reasons, they were cut from the final game.

The Valley of Emperors (Japanese: , Ōke no Tani) is a landmark in . It is located on the second basement floor of the High Entia Tomb. When the party first reaches the valley, there is a guardian that they must defeat to progress further into the tomb. A Heart-to-Heart - "Echoes of Ancient Times" - is located here.

The Upper Trachea (Japanese: , Tainai Jōbu Kikan-ji) is a landmark in . It is located on the upper level of the Bionis' Interior. It is reachable by swimming towards the geyser found in the Third Lung, and leads out of Bionis into Makna Forest. There are no enemies here, and only one collectable.

The Underground Store (Japanese: , Chika Chozōko) is a location in . It is located on the basement level of Frontier Village. As the name suggests, it is the place where all the foods are stored. A river also runs inside the place that ends in a Reservoir.

Vagabond Allocer (Japanese: , Rurō no Arokeru) is Unique Monster in . It is a Mechon and can be found at level 63 in Agniratha. Like all enemies in Agniratha, it is a Mechon. It can be found just north of the Helas Pillar. It must be defeated in order to complete the timed quest Military Status 1 - 1.

Vang Teeth are rare materials in . They can only be dropped by Little Vangs in Colony 9 or traded for with Dionysis. According to their description, they are pretty little snaggleteeth that would be nice on a necklace. Two are needed for Colony 9's Material Quest 3.

Vagrant Alfead (Japanese: , Fūrai no Arufīdo) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 16 at the Tirkin Headquarters on Bionis' Leg. It must be defeated for the Challenge 2 - Part 2 quest. It can drop a Tirkin Crest, which is needed for Material Quest 2.

Unine Hodes are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Hode family, and can be found at level 33 Eryth Sea. They can be found at Showdown Cliff, Hovering Reefs 2 and 3. Five of them need to be defeated in order to complete Alcamoth's Monster Quest 3 - Part 1.

Vang Third Molars are rare materials in . They can be dropped by Vangs on Bionis' Leg or traded for in Colony 9 with Suzanna. According to their description, they are teeth prone to decay, and they are the mandibular third molars to be precise. Three are needed for Material Quest 4 on Bionis' Leg.

The Upper Bulkhead Bridge (Japanese: , Kishin Daikakuheki Jōbu Renrakukyō) is a landmark in . It is located on the fourth floor of Mechonis Field, reached from the Patella Exhaust. When the party gets to the west end of the bridge, three Mechon will swoop down.
Upgraded Shafts are rare materials in . They can be dropped by Mechon M82 or trade for with Gowago.
Upgraded Spindles are rare materials in . They can be obtained from large Mechon in the Ether Mine or by trading.
Upgraded Plungers are rare materials in . They can only be traded for with Pokapoka and Emmy Leater.
Upa Death Stones are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Unfinished Business (引けない戦い, Unfinished Battle) is an Event Track in and , composed and arranged by Yoko Shimomura, with additional string arrangement by Tsutomu Narita. It is track 18 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a pre-battle theme that is heard in two cutscenes, one happening outside of the Ether Mine on Freight Road when Dickson and Dunban arrive to help the party against Metal Face and his Mechon force, and another happening in where Melia and Shulk help Tyrea from a Fogbeast. In both circumstances, this song will play during the battles after each cutscene. However, if the party loses to the Deinos Sauros, this song will be replaced with Fogbeasts duri

Urgency (焦り, Impatience) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 13 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a heightened, urgent theme that is heard in several cutscenes during Shulk and Reyn's struggle for survival against the Arachnos infesting Tephra Cave: * When Shulk awakens from a dream to find Reyn and himself surrounded by Arachnos. * When Reyn is captured in an Arachno's web. * When Reyn is being chased by Arachnos and Shulk must climb some vines at Vilia Lake to save him. In , this song plays when Shulk and Melia follow the sounds of a fight after Junks crash lands, and again in Alcamoth until the battle against the Snowal Taos. It

Urban is a Light Type based Skell unit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Urban is one of the Skells developed and used by BLADE in New Los Angeles. It is Lin's favourite Skell. The Urban is specially designed for urban deployment and combat. Its vehicle form is a sort of futuristic motorcycle. Urbans are one of the few Skell series that can be found on New Los Angeles used by BLADE soldiers. Most Human-Made Skell enemies are Urban models. The US0220 Urban ST model is the first Skell Cross receives upon completing the mission The Skell License, and one of the two Level 20 Skell frames available to the player, the other being the initial Hraesvelg model. The level 60 upgrade of this Skell is the Urba

Uncontrollable is a track in , composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano with original lyrics by mpi and vocals provided by mpi and Mika Kobayashi. It is track four of disc two from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. This music is heard during most Tyrant battles (except Nahum, the Red Hare and Nardacyon, the Shadowless; Lugalbanda, the Wanderer-King; Dadaan, the Strongest Prone; Pharsis, the Everqueen; Vortice, the Deific Blast; Phanatos, the Netherlord; and Telethia, the Endbringer) and will begin playing as soon as the Tyrant has detected the lead party member. This music also plays when battling Grenade Pizza F in Murder Most Foul, and against MG068: Megisia in Slovity's Revenge. An inst
Ultraslash is one of Gwin's two Signature Arts in . Cross learns this art after completing Nine Lives.
Underdog is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It may trigger upon reducing the health of a sufficiently large enemy by half while being on foot.
Untouchable is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered when a party member manages to evade three consecutive enemy hits.

Valyrian, the Iron Cleaver (Japanese: , Zantetsu no Vareriyan) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Ictus and can be found at level 48 at the northern end of the Alexander Ridge in Oblivia.

Uncanny Vespers (Japanese: , Māberu Usuperu, Marvel Vesper) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vesper family, and can be found at level 25-26 in West Ibra Ravine in Oblivia.
Uncanny Murras (Japanese: , Māberu Tondomu, Marvel Murra) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Murra family, and can be found at level 62-63 in Sylvalum's Sandsprint Cavity.

Unyielding Forfexes (Japanese: , Wiru Pagurusu) are three Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 28-29 on the Great Washington Isle in Oblivia. Defeating them is required during Arms and the Man.

Vampire Blattas (Japanese: , Vanpu Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family. They can be found at level 38-40 in Cauldros, near FN Site 504 or FN Site 506.

Umbral Adseculas (Japanese: , Shēdo Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found in Primordia at level 44-45 around and north of Talon Rock Third Terrane, level 46 southwest of Arendt Bridge, and level 48 (nonaggressive) at Seaswept Base around the insect hive in the southeast.

Unafulges (Japanese: , Purumō) are floating polyp-like Piscinoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Their bodies are somewhat box-shaped with curved, spiked tendrils protruding from the corners, a gel cap on top, and a short stem-like structure below. They can be found in Primordia, Noctilum, and Sylvalum.
Upper Hushflood (Japanese: , Shinkan Taiga Jōryūku) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, north of Middle Hushflood and south of the Celestial Ascent.
Vagabond Ants (Japanese: , Sasuraiari) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia.

The Vasara is an intergalactic holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts the Vasara Skell piloted by Ga Jiarg and can be obtained from it after being defeated at Shivering Sands in Sylvalum during the final battle of Chapter 9.

Valeriano, the Rolling Thunder (Japanese: , Banrai no Bareriano) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Duoguill family. It can be found at level 26 in Oblivia at Leaning Ring during an electromagnetic storm.

Vainamo, the Bellower (Japanese: , Dogō no Vainamo) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Vigent family. It can be found at level 39 at Capital Wreckage in Cauldros. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Vainamo, the Bellower. It must also be defeated during the Normal Mission Entrepreneurial Spirit.

Uluora, the Burgeoning (Japanese: , Mebuki no Uruora) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Monoceros family. It can be found at level 22 on the cliff above the ruins northwest of Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros.

Vegetal, the Heatcrux (Japanese: , Netsukaku no Behetaru) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Sacrifole family. It can be found at level 49 south of FN Site 506 in Cauldros in a small circular lava pool.

Urdu's Qmoeva (Japanese: , Urudu Sen'yō Kumūba) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Qmoeva Ganglion's skell. It can be found hidden at level 55 at the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros during late night. It is the Qmoeva of WR512: Urdu. It reflects physical damage.

The Unlimited Output Zig (Japanese: , Shutsuryoku Seigen Kaijo-gata Jigu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Zig Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 43 south of Sunset Falls in Cauldros.

The Urban Lincoln is a Skell in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the level 60 version of the Urban skell and becomes available after completing Chapter 12. Like all other Level 60 Skells it cannot be purchased, but instead must be created at the AM Terminal.

Upgraded Lenses are common materials in . They can be obtained from Seidr in Sylvalum and Cauldros. Eight of them are required to construct an Ares 70 Skell, and sixteen are need to construct an Ares 90. They are dropped by the same enemies which drop Seidr Control Devices, which are also needed to build the Ares Skells.

Valiant Cetos (Japanese: , Varianto Burikio) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ceto family, and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros, above White Phosphor Lake during the night.
Upgraded Coils are common materials in . They can be obtained from Oc-servs. One is needed for A Girl's Wings.
Unwavering Courage is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Striker at rank 3.
Upgraded Jammers are common materials in . They can be obtained from Quos.
Unfertilized Auravis Eggs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Auravises.
Unpleasant Dream is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Psycorruptor at rank 9.
Until the End (Japanese: , Chūgishin, Loyal Heart) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Vi Sezha at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia.
Uzoma Vassago (Japanese: , Uzoma Vasago) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles at night.
Unafulge Numbing Toxins are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from pinkish Unafulges.

Unknown Assailant (Japanese: , Korondasu-tai no Junan, Agony of Corwin's Squad) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Raleigh on Division Drive in the Administrative District. Although not a prerequisite, the Basic Mission Team Corwin in Crisis can be used to locate this mission.

Unsatisfied Customer (Japanese: , Kōru Rikōru, Call and Recall) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Chiroro at the Floating Reef in Oblivia. It becomes available after seeing Felice complain to Chiroro at the Commercial District's Nopon Bazaar.
Unlucky Black Whiskers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Cetos. They are components in crafting the True series of BLADE Wear.
Unafulge Death Toxins are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from purplish Unafulges that dwell in areas of magma.

The Vanitas Seidr (Japanese: , Vani Basugia) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 39 Seidr machine, and can be found in Oblivia's Jair Fortress. It must be defeated within ten minutes during A Dish Served Cold.

Vanguard Glennar (Japanese: , Van Gurennā) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Prone Ganglion soldier. He is fought at level 30 in Mesa Fortress in Oblivia during Kidnapped: Uzoma Vassago.

Under the Weather is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Nan'celeg and the primary destination is the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. It leads into House Call, though accepting it is not a prerequisite.
Vanquishing Visigels is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Curators and the primary destination is Cauldros.

The Unruly Petramand (Japanese: , Raiotto Aranea, Riot Petramand) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 38 member of the Petramand family, and is fought in Oblivia's Devil's Colony during one route of The Ultimate Price.
Urban Planning is Nagi's third Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs in the morning near the transport airship on North Founders Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.

Vasara War Medals are intergalactic materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vasara, for 210 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks, or for 475 Material Tickets from the Material Market in . They can also be given out by Squad Missions and Time Attack Missions featuring Vasara. It's needed to make Hraesvelg Lord.
Upgraded Sensor Parts are common materials in . They can be obtained from Zigs.
Upgraded Shaft Parts are rare materials in . They can be obtained from Zig Tyrants that have shield-shaped weapons.
Upgraded Spindle Parts are rare materials in . They can be obtained from Shrads.
Unafulge B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a lava unafulge variant. It can be obtained from Ruth, the Shunner of Light in Sylvalum.

Unknown (Male) is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a male mannequin wearing a complete set of BLADE Wear from an unknown manufacturer. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Then and Now. The Unknown BLADE wear available in game are: ; Head * Infinite Comm * Regal Comm * Reginal Comm * True Comm ; Torso * Infinite Plastron * Regal Plastron * Reginal Plastron * True Plastron ; Left Arm * Infinite Bangle L * Regal Bangle L * Reginal Bangle L * True Bangle L ; Right Arm * Infinite Bangle R * Regal Bangle R * Reginal Bangle R * True Bangle R ; Leg * Infinite Cords * Regal Cords * Reginal Cords * True Cords

XCX= |-| XCX:DE= Under Construction is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.4, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting sixteen Germivores. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Unknown Transport is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.15, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting five Dobromila, the Alluring. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Unnatural Disaster is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.20, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting five Myuena Cacti. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Unwelcome Guests is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.20, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting ten Viragos. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Unfathomable Devil Wings are a casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They share their appearance with the other Devil Wings items, and can only be found in a Treasure Box in Cauldros, north of the Capital Wreckage.
Untouchable Dash is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases evasion while sprinting.

The Unbreakable Sword is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is forged by De Zing and must be recovered from the Brute Millepod, northwest of FN Site 516 in Cauldros, during The Unbreakable Sword.
Vantage Attack Plus is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that increases damage dealt when attacking from above an enemy. The Skell equivalent is PositionDmg.ABOVE.
Ultrafauna Criticals Up is a ground weapon critical Augment in and that increases critical chance when attacking Ultrafauna-classified enemies. The Skell equivalent is CriticalUp.ULTRAFAUNA.
Ultrafauna Slayer is a ground weapon enemy exploit Augment in and that increases damage dealt to Ultrafauna-classified enemies. The Skell equivalent is Slayer.ULTRAFAUNA.
Underdog Surge is a ground weapon Soul Voice augment in and . It increases the chances of triggering the Underdog Soul Voice by 10% to 50%.

The Vanquisher's Eyepatch is Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained from a Treasure Box which requires Biological Field-Skill level 3, and is located at the east end of an elevated walkway southeast of Mount M'gando in Cauldros.
Utoto is an NPC in . Utoto is a Nopon who can be found at Lemour Inn in the Argentum Trade Guild. Utoto runs Lemour Inn.

Umon's Shipyard (Japanese: , Umon no Zōsenjo) is a landmark in . It is located near the rear of Gormott, on the left upper level of the Gormott Province. Umon, a Nopon shipbuilder and Tora's uncle, resides here. Although he appears even if the party approaches before recruiting Tora, he may not be interacted with as an NPC until then.
Umon is an NPC in . He is a Nopon and an old friend of Tora's father; Tora considers him as an uncle. He resides at his shipyard near the rear of Gormott. Umon proposes the quest Umon Bounces Back.
Umon's Ship (Japanese: , Umon no Fune) is a Main Story Quest in . It is received from Umon at his shipyard in the Gormott Province.

Urchons (Japanese: , Unin) are a family of enemies in the , first appearing in . They look like sea urchins and come in red and blue varieties. They are often encountered after Salvaging or near water. In , one of the four Golden Monsters in the Kingdom of Torna is an Urchon. Urchons have multiple defining traits. Firstly, they have a relatively high Guard Rate and can block attacks from any side. And secondly, they cannot normally be inflicted with Break. However, during their "Bouncy Hammer" and "Spiky Hammer" arts, a fleshy stem in their middle is revealed, and they are treated as being inflicted with Break for the art's duration. Vampire Bride Marion (Japanese: , Kyūketsu Kifujin no Mamon) is a Unique Monster in . She is a member of the Parisax family at level 65 and can be found at the Dragon's Stomach in the Kingdom of Uraya. After some time, it will spawn some Martz Parisax and Burrig Parisax. She must be defeated to unlock Kasandra's level 5 Sentimental Burst on her Affinity Chart.

Varnax's Plunge (Japanese: , Vānasuku Ōtaki) is a landmark in . It is a giant waterfall located on the right upper level of the Gormott Province, directly under the Verdant Plateau. A wide valley connects the lake the waterfall empties into to Garanti Plain.

Valdorm's Mound (Japanese: , Varudomu no Oka) is a location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain, directly east and above the Cargo Transportation Zone. It can be reached by exiting the Old Plumbing Entrance from the pipes within the Great Heat Extraction Duct, and must be visited during the Blade Quest Crystal Clear.

The Uraya Merc Barracks (Japanese: , Invidia Yatoi Heidan Heisha) are a Location in . They are located in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, between the Entertainment District and Sevind Palace Plaza.

The Underground River Lavi (Japanese: , Ravia Chika Suiryū) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of Spirit Crucible Elpys, between the Bone Road and the Grave Robbers' Haunt. It consists of a long winding river criss-crossed by overhead paths. The first part of the river is toxic and will cause damage if stepped in. There is a malign miasma here requiring level 5 Dark Mastery and level Ancient Wisdom field skills to dispel. It leads to a platform containing a single Treasure Trove.

The Vault of Heroes (Japanese: , Eirei no Ma) is a location in . It is located on the Lower Level of Spirit Crucible Elpys, beyond the Portal of the Hero, and is also presumably the resting place of Addam alongside being the hidden location of the third Aegis Sword. A Treasure Trove here contains a Pouch Expansion Kit. The Heart-to-heart "Eternal Rest" can be viewed here. Visiting this location with Elma, Mythra, Nia in the party is necessary to unlock Elma's level 4 "Keen Eye" Field Skill.

Upper Level - Right (Japanese: , Jōsō – Migihanshin) is a level of the Gormott Province in , connecting Torigoth and the Lower Level with the Upper Level - Left. It is the only accessible area of Gormott in .
Upper Level - Left (Japanese: , Jōsō - Hidarihanshin) is a level in . It is located in the Gormott Province, beyond Upper Level - Right.
The Upper Level (Japanese: , Jōsō) of the Empire of Mor Ardain is a level in . It is directly above the Lower Level, and houses Alba Cavanich and Hardhaigh Palace.
The Vargel Deeds are deeds Key Items in . They can be purchased from Vargel Tavern in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Vargel Tavern is a shop in . It is run by Garddi and can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya's Garfont Village. It is specialized in Drinks.
Urma is an NPC in . Urma is an Ardainian who can be found in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Urma runs a shop called Griogair's Greens specialized in Veggies.
Upper Edge (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Big Bang Edge.
Vajra Blow (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Shield Hammer. It inflicts Topple.

Vagrant Baldr (Japanese: , Sasurai no Reinoruzu) is a Unique Monster in . He is a human-like enemy mounted in a small Titan fighter, and is a member of the Brionac. He can be found at level 62 patrolling the air all over the Brionac Occupied Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 5 Adamantine Axe Blade Special. His Tombstone is located in the northwest corner of the Brionac Occupied Zone.

Unflinching Saxton (Japanese: , Ikkitōsen no Sakuson) is a Unique Monster in . He is a Driver enemy, and can be found at level 99 at the Work Observation Tower in the Empire of Mor Ardain after the party reaches the First Low Orbit Station.

Valt Ropl (Japanese: , Varuto Ryibura) are enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family, and one can be found at level 49 - 51 inside the crater in the floor at the Balquors Ruins on the Upper Level of the Cliffs of Morytha. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Mythra's level 4 Ray of Punishment, and Mikhail's level 2 "Dark Mastery".
Vegetable Mille-Feuilles are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Corcaja Greengrocers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Veg & Oyster Aspics are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Corcaja Greengrocers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Vallum Ageshus (Japanese: , Varun Ākeshu) are enemies in . They are members of the Ageshu family, and can be found at level 39-42 at the Xataris Spring on the Central Plain of Temperantia. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Nim's level 2 "Earth Mastery" on her affinity chart.

Vashar Caterpiles (Japanese: , Wasshā Kyapiru) are enemies in . They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 45-47 at the Wonder Spring Plaza Ruins on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Kasandra's level 4 Secret Desire.

Uluran Gradies (Japanese: , Ururā Guradi) are enemies in . They are members of the Grady family, and can be found at level 31-33 in the water around Baldotas Isle in the Rigitte Waters of the Leftherian Archipelago. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Nim's level 3 Organic Automata and Kora's level 3 Vivid Love.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Unicorn Scarves (Japanese: , Yunikōn Mafurā) are accessories in and . They extend the duration of the Break reaction by up to 34% (3.4 seconds). This effect will only apply when the wearer inflicts the reaction. They are the upgraded version of the Chrome Scarf accessory. The Quantum Scarf and Tachyon Scarf accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.
Unita Trading is a shop in . It is run by Epplid and can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya's Garfont Village. It is specialized in Exchange.

Vay Taos (Japanese: , Vahhe Taōsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Taos family and can be found at level 58-60 at the 7th Perimeter Skyport in the World Tree. Four of them must be defeated in order to unlock Pyra's level 5 Flame Nova, as well as Perdido's Level 3 Fire Mastery.

Ureilite Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be dropped by a variety of enemies primarily in the Kingdom of Tantal, or received as quest rewards for Newt Recruits, Umon Bounces Back, and A Hat Fit for a Lady (DLC quest). They are especially common during Newt Recruits as several of the quest-exclusive enemies also drop the Chips. Ureilite Chips share their appearance with Lodranite Chips, Brachinite Chips, and Winonaite Chips. __TOC__

Vacuum Brogs (Japanese: , Bakyūmu Guroggu) are two Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Brog family that are fought at level 25 in the Forgotten Waste in the Gormott Province during Into the Open Sky.

Vasq is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. He is located at the end of a winding wooden balcony east of Maluria Antiques. He gives Vasq's Recipe, which allows Pyra to prepare Roast Meat Tagliata. He offers the Merc Mission Rainbow Shell. He is angry about how he is treated by his superiors in the royal kitchens as a cook but aspires to someday make food for Queen Raqura.

Vandham's Last Wish (Japanese: , Vandamu no Ishi, Vandham's Will) is a Main Story Quest in . It is received after completing Chapter 3. The quest introduces the player to the Merc Group and Merc Mission mechanics.

Vaids Serpronds (Japanese: , Vidasu Rodon) are enemies in . They are members of the Serprond family, and can be found at level 47 - 51 at the Morytha Falls or near the Jubilee Gate on the Cliffs of Morytha after Salvaging.
Valkan Marrins (Japanese: , Varukan Mārin) are enemies in . They are members of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 59 - 63 at the 7th Perimeter Skyport in the World Tree after Salvaging.

The Vaido Sovereign (Japanese: , Vaito Roiyaru) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a Sovereign that is fought at level 57 at the Data Processing Room in the World Tree during the quest Limits of Awareness.

Urobas Serpronds (Japanese: , Urobosu Rodon) are enemies in . They are members of the Serprond family, and can be found at level 32-38 through Salvaging in the Chansagh Wastes and at level 38-43 in the Chansagh Wastes and one in the Cloud Sea near the Old Factory during high tide in the Empire of Mor Ardain, they behave hostilely like any Salvage Point Enemy.

The Vacillus Antol (Japanese: , Vashirisu Antoru) is a Quest-Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Antol family, and can be found at level 44 at the Ruined Chapel of Danafas in Temperantia during the quest A Phonex Tale.
Umon Bounces Back is a quest in . It can be received from Umon at the Grodd Residential Zone in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.

Uncover the Truth is a quest in . It can be received from the Notice Board in the Central Exchange of the Argentum Trade Guild. The quests The Nopon Murals and The Riddle on the Wall will need to be completed during the objectives progression.
